sampler.method: seeded legal random playouts; 32% wall decision probability when walls remain; pawn moves favor shortest-path progress 72% of the time
sampler.selection: round-robin across wall-count, own-distance, and opponent-flank buckets

evaluation.policy: raw model logits masked to legal root actions, then softmax
evaluation.value: child value head converted to root-player perspective; terminal children use exact +/-1
evaluation.defense_definition: opponent has an immediate legal winning pawn move before root action and has none after it
